args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia Marchetti's request in #coastal-team:

• Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
• Moss's coverage digest notes a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
• Please use Pellow Home Living for the account name going forward, and check any saved reports or labels still showing Covey & Lark.
• Flag the "Covey — Late Arrivals" report to whoever owns it so it can be renamed.
• For the PHL filter: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia (drafted by assistant for Bettina Kroll)
